metadata.description: Open-source project manager skills for Claude and Codex

plugins.name: project-manager-skills
plugins.description: Project manager skills for Claude Code, Cowork and Codex: meeting minutes, meeting agendas, decision log, action items, RAID log, status reports, 1:1s, skip-level meetings, standups, retrospectives, morning brief, project charter, team charter, change control, RACI matrix, stakeholder map and lessons learned. The skills share one folder of Markdown records.

plugins.name: meeting-minutes
plugins.description: Meeting minutes from a transcript or notes: decisions accepted and not accepted, action items with owners and dates, risks, open questions and a recap message.

plugins.name: meeting-agenda
plugins.description: Meeting agendas built from what is still open: overdue actions, decisions due for a revisit, risks and leftovers. Each item has an outcome, a lead and a time box.

plugins.name: decision-log
plugins.description: A decision log: records decisions with who decided and why, finds past ones with their source, flags contradictions and decisions due for a revisit.

plugins.name: action-items
plugins.description: One action list across meetings: owners, due dates, what is overdue and polite follow-ups. Creates tracker tickets with the meeting context after you confirm.

plugins.name: raid-log
plugins.description: A RAID log and risk register: risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies, each with an owner, a mitigation and a weekly review of what changed.

plugins.name: status-report
plugins.description: Weekly project status reports with an honest RAG status, built from the record. Also rolls several projects up into one page.

plugins.name: one-on-one
plugins.description: 1:1 prep and notes with your reports or your manager, kept in a private running doc per person.

plugins.name: standup
plugins.description: Async standup summaries with blockers first and who can unblock them, plus work that has not moved.

plugins.name: retrospective
plugins.description: Sprint retrospectives, project post-mortems and lessons learned, grounded in what happened, ending with a few owned actions.

plugins.name: morning-brief
plugins.description: A one-page morning brief: what needs you today to decide, unblock or do, plus prep for today's meetings. Read-only.

plugins.name: project-charter
plugins.description: Project charter from a kickoff transcript or notes: goal, measurable success criteria, scope in and out, milestones, who approves changes, plus seed rows for the RAID log, decisions and actions.

plugins.name: change-control
plugins.description: Scope change control: change requests with the impact on scope, dates, budget, people and risks, a change log, and plan updates after the owner decides.

plugins.name: raci-matrix
plugins.description: RACI matrix from the charter, actions and decisions: one accountable person per row, gaps and bottlenecks flagged, and answers to who decides on what.

plugins.name: stakeholder-map
plugins.description: Stakeholder map and communication plan: interest and influence, what each person needs to hear, how and how often, and who needs to hear about a change.

plugins.name: lessons-learned
plugins.description: Lessons learned register and closure report: lessons from retros and reviews with sources, what came of past decisions, and matching lessons for a new project.

plugins.name: team-charter
plugins.description: Team charter and working agreements: what the team is for and owns, how it decides, its agreements and meetings, kept true at each retro.

plugins.name: skip-level-meeting
plugins.description: Skip-level meeting prep and private notes, themes across a round without names, and what to take back to the lead.
